sources.title: Light rail — Newcastle Transport
sources.note: Newcastle light rail runs from Newcastle Interchange in Wickham to Newcastle Beach in the east end of Newcastle. Six convenient stops.

notes: D1 oracle is the official Newcastle Transport light rail map plus the linked NLR timetable PDF, HAND-TRANSCRIBED. Stations arrays are not generated from GTFS. H2 name-clash is against TfNSW GTFS schedule/lightrail/newcastle (same TFNSW_API_KEY as Sydney). No stopIds in this file.

City id newcastle is a SEPARATE city from sydney. Do not merge into Sydney light rail or NSW TrainLink / Central Coast & Hunter heavy rail. Modes v1: TRAIN-like light rail only (NLR). No buses, ferry (Stockton), or NSW TrainLink to Sydney in the oracle.
Timezone Australia/Sydney HAS DST (AEDT/AEST). Do not copy Brisbane / Gold Coast no-DST.
One printed line: Newcastle Light Rail, passenger code NLR. Termini Newcastle Interchange and Newcastle Beach.

Locked rail-interchange printed name: Newcastle Interchange (map hub with T+B+L). Not Wickham, not Newcastle Interchange Light Rail, not Newcastle Station. Timetable column adds suburb: Newcastle Interchange, Wickham. GTFS parent is Newcastle Interchange (location_type=1); child Newcastle Interchange Light Rail.
Locked beach terminus: Newcastle Beach (map). Not Newcastle East (suburb label on the map), not Newcastle Beach Light Rail. Timetable column: Newcastle Beach, Newcastle.
Civic is an intermediate stop, not the hub. Do not confuse with Canberra Civic / Alinga Street.
gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown is the passenger code NLR. Keyed feed route_id NT_NLR. No stopIds in this file.
coverageGaps: No passenger extension west of Newcastle Interchange (Broadmeadow corridor is strategic / not on the official NLR map). Not inserted.
NSW TrainLink / Central Coast & Hunter trains at Newcastle Interchange are out of v1. Same parent name Newcastle Interchange in the NLR GTFS — doNotGroup train vs light rail children.
Stockton ferry at Queens Wharf is out of v1.
Timetable PDF still dated 03/04/2022; stop names match the current map. Frequency on the Newcastle Transport page (5am–1am, ~7.5 min peak) is the live product, not a new stop list.
PDF hex / TfNSW red EE343F are legend/feed metadata, not D1 print locks.
